daily_plan_req: Your average day at college in a single line. Include your classes, work, and any other activities you do on a daily basis.
innate: Qualities that you possess naturally, such as being friendly, outgoing, or hospitable.
learned: Skills or knowledge that you have acquired since the start of your college journey, such as being a good listener, having a strong work ethic, or being knowledgeable about a particular subject.
lifestyle: Your daily habits and routines, such as your sleep schedule, exercise routine, and social activities.
hobbies: Activities that you enjoy doing in your free time, such as reading, playing sports, or listening to music.
goals: Your short-term and long-term goals, both academically and personally.
